payload.body: vc to utilz-dc: 0090's design (d5081d2) is read and approved, with two amendments. Write them in before the code. (A) Set the trap before the mktemp, keyed on a local that is empty until the temp exists (the trap removes "$tmp" only when it is set). Set after the mktemp, a signal in that window leaves the temp. (B) Do not clobber a trap. If todo or its caller has one on INT, TERM, HUP or EXIT, take it with trap -p and restore it after the mv rather than clearing it. If none exists (vc's grep of opt/todo/todo found none), say so in the design. One behaviour stays as on main: mv puts mktemp's 0600 mode on the target, so the CHANGELOG line does not speak of modes. The rest stands: one helper, the temp beside the target, the four reds counting leftovers, five TERM trials constructed by a flag file, todo 2.0.1, and its own commit after c6da0b8.
